paper_diagnosis: Multimodal treatment of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder and comorbid symptoms in an ultra football fan: A case report from Switzerland
disease_label_per_paper: Adult attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder with comorbid alcohol misuse and insomnia

demographics.age_note: First evaluated and treated for ADHD at age 40; article describes follow-up at age 47.

presentation_summary: A Swiss male ultra football fan was first evaluated at a specialized adult ADHD clinic at age 40 and later reported as a 47-year-old in follow-up.
He presented with impulsivity, forgetfulness, irritability, temper problems, inattention, alcohol misuse, and insomnia.
Developmental history included academic underachievement, behavioral problems, disorganization, forgetfulness, erratic school attendance, and poor academic performance.
Adult functioning was impaired by occupational and interpersonal instability, substance misuse, risky sports injuries, and recurrent football-related violence.
Structured adult ADHD assessment showed abnormal HASE-related scales: ADHS-SB score 30, WURS-K score 32, and WRAADDSI score 46.
